g2-implement.title: G2 s_e estimator + companion disagreement rate + clamp/flag + quali path + artifact: implement
g2-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for G2. Build a NEW module src/evo_predictor/spread_target.py that derives per-event s_e. ESTIMATOR (D3.5): s_e = MEDIAN over unordered pairs of (pace_gap_ij / (pi_i - pi_j)), where pace_gap_ij = gap_i - gap_j (fraction-of-median, from G1's chosen race observable for race/race_start; from compute_pace_gaps on get_quali_best_valid_laps_batch for quali per D3.7) and (pi_i - pi_j) = retro power diff read READ-ONLY from params/retro_truth (use existing latent_power retro loaders; pair only drivers present in both pace and retro). Skip pairs with |pi_i - pi_j| below a small epsilon (degenerate denominator). FLOOR-AS-GUARDRAIL: clamp non-positive/degenerate per-event s_e to a small positive value and FLAG those events (boolean field) — do NOT silently fix. COMPANION STAT (D3.6): per-event pace-vs-finish sign-disagreement RATE as its OWN field (fraction of pairs where sign(pace_gap_ij) != sign(pi_i - pi_j)); do NOT blend into s_e. QUALI (D3.7): same estimator on quali gaps, no caution machinery. ARTIFACT: emit per-event records {year, round, phase in {race, race_start, quali}, s_e, clamped flag, disagreement_rate, n_pairs}; choose a cheap/reversible on-disk shape (e.g. params/spread_target/ JSON, mirroring retro_truth layout) — log the shape choice PROMINENTLY as a reconciliation decision; consumable by #386 sigma + #391. As-of note (D3.2): s_e is a post-event LABEL (sees the event's own laps); as-of discipline applies to FEATURES that predict it later, not here. Dispatch constellation-implementer. Integrate IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.
